captions.caption: Flames consume dry sticks inside a rustic mud stove.
The fire crackles as it spreads through the wooden fuel pieces.
A close-up view of orange flames licking the interior of the stove.
Intense heat emanates from the burning wood stacked inside the stove.
The fire burns steadily, illuminating the dark interior of the mud structure.
Smoke rises from the burning branches tucked deep inside the stove.
The camera pans up to show the top opening of the rectangular stove.
Faint smoke drifts out of the top of the mud-built stove structure.
A wide shot of the mud stove situated outdoors in a natural setting.
Close-up of vibrant orange flames dancing over several pieces of charred wood.
The wood pieces turn black as the fire intensifies within the mud stove.
Bright flames swirl and leap within the confines of the clay oven.
A pile of dry, split wood is stacked neatly on the ground.
A person's knee is visible next to the large stack of firewood.
The person crouches near the wood pile, getting ready to tend the fire.
A shirtless man with long hair crouches beside the mud stove entrance.
The man reaches for a small stick from the pile to add fuel.
He carefully feeds the small branches into the bottom opening of the stove.
More fuel is added to the growing fire inside the mud-brick structure.
The man continues to insert thin sticks into the heart of the flames.
He picks up a mud brick from the ground in front of the stove.
The man places the brick at the entrance to manage the fire's airflow.
He adjusts the positioning of the bricks near the base of the stove.
The man stays in a crouched position, observing the fire's steady progress.
He looks closely into the stove opening at the burning pile of wood.
The man remains attentive, monitoring the heat within the mud-built oven.
A close-up view of the vigorous fire burning through the dry wood.
The interior of the stove is filled with bright and flickering flames.
Flames lick the top edge of the front opening of the stove.
The wood continues to burn down, creating a bed of very hot coals.
Glowing embers begin to form at the base of the wood fire.
Intense heat is visible in the bright orange and yellow leaping flames.
The fire starts to settle into a steady and hot burn.
A view of the glowing red embers and small charred wood fragments.
The coals glow intensely with heat inside the dark mud stove.
English text on screen notes the items were left in for an hour.
The glowing bed of coals is disturbed as if being searched through.
Spanish text appears on screen over the image of the glowing hot embers.
A stick is used to poke and stir the red-hot coals inside.
The person carefully moves the glowing wood to reveal hidden contents.
A dark, rounded object begins to emerge from the bed of hot embers.
Sparks fly as the person continues to dig through the hot red coals.
More of the hidden object is uncovered from the intense fire heat.
The stick gently pushes aside glowing fragments of wood and hot charcoal.
Small flames flare up as the coals are shifted around by the person.
A clay turtle figure is partially revealed amidst the hot burning embers.
The person uses the stick to clear more coals from the turtle figure.
The dark shell of the clay turtle becomes more visible in the fire.
Glowing coals surround the base of the fired clay turtle figure.
The turtle figure sits directly in the path of the intense heat.
The stick continues to uncover the head and flippers of the turtle.
Hot embers are moved away to show the full shape of the piece.
Flames dance around the newly uncovered clay turtle figure in the stove.
The person adjusts the wood around the turtle to ensure even heating.
A close-up of the clay turtle shell glowing in the firelight.
The turtle figure remains still as the fire continues to burn around it.
Glowing red light from the coals reflects off the clay turtle surface.
The head of the clay turtle is shown in profile amidst the embers.
Flickering flames partially obscure the view of the turtle figure in the oven.
The clay turtle is seen clearly sitting in the bed of hot fire.
